items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a writer, black writer named James Weldon Johnson, he wrote the Negro national anthem, Lift Every Voice and Sing. And he, let me tell you this, he wrote a thing called The Creation, and that turned me onto how the music started and how everything does this.

ctx.x: I had a, you know, I’ve got one other like that, Rich Clements is like that, you know. He’s with me all the way, he’ll be at choir rehearsal, you know, he’ll be in the class. You know, so I’ve been fortunate. You know, at least I have a few people who can play come to class, that’s the beauty. See, I want, I should really be teaching, I shouldn’t be teaching the students, I should be teaching the teachers, you know. That’s the way it should be. I have so many secrets to tell them about the music, stuff that…
